About Froda
Founded in 2015, Froda’s mission is to democratize access to financing, giving small businesses the same growth opportunities as large ones. Through digital innovation, we’ve transformed the loan process from months to minutes, offering fair, fast, and accessible financing. Now, through embedded lending, we’re integrating our technology with global banks and fintechs, building the next generation of lending infrastructure. Join us in creating opportunities for small businesses to invest in their ideas to the best possible terms.
About the Role
As an Engineering Manager at Froda, you will lead 2–3 cross-functional product teams and ensure we deliver value clearly, predictably, and with high quality. Working closely with Product Managers and Tech Leads, you will create focus, remove obstacles, and build strong teams that can move fast while maintaining a healthy and reliable platform, working iteratively to ship, learn, and continuously improve our products and systems.
Through close collaboration with your teams, you will help shape the technical direction of the areas you lead, connecting business needs with sustainable engineering decisions and ensuring we continuously improve how we build, ship, and learn from what we deliver.
In this role, you will:

Drive delivery across multiple teams by improving how teams plan, execute, and follow up on their work, ensuring priorities and commitments are realistic and aligned with business goals while supporting iterative delivery and continuous learning

Identify and manage risks, dependencies, and capacity challenges early

Support a healthy balance between product delivery and technical improvements

Coach and develop engineers while fostering a sustainable and high-performing team environment

Build strong cross-functional relationships across Product, Tech, Commercial, and Partnerships

This role offers the opportunity to have a real impact on how teams collaborate, deliver, and evolve our platform at a fintech company with strong momentum and a stable foundation, backed by a banking license as a quality stamp.
Who are you?
We believe you are an engineering leader who thrives in dynamic, fast-moving environments. You enjoy creating clarity in complexity and building teams that deliver value continuously while improving how they work.
You are confident in stakeholder dialogue, comfortable navigating ambiguity, and proactive in driving improvements rather than waiting for direction. You lead with calmness, ownership, and a strong sense of accountability.
You are fluent in English, Swedish is a plus.
We believe you have experience with:

Leading engineering teams in a product-focused tech organization

Driving delivery, planning, and execution across teams with a focus on predictability and quality

A solid technical background that allows you to understand architectural trade-offs and engineering challenges

Coaching and developing engineers through continuous feedback and performance follow-up

Working closely with Product Managers and Tech Leads to balance scope, risk, and long-term improvements

Improving development processes, ways of working, and engineering practices

Navigating cross-functional collaboration and stakeholder management

What’s in it for you?
At Froda, you’ll be part of a company that combines the best of both worlds – a fast-moving, high-energy culture with the stability and structure to support long-term success. We’re 100+ ambitious self-starters who genuinely care for each other and the work we do, all while having fun together.
Here, you’ll have the opportunity to shape how we execute and scale engineering, influence both delivery and long-term platform evolution, and build high-performing teams with real ownership. With big ambitions and a rapidly evolving business, there’s plenty of room to grow, take initiative, and make a lasting impact on both our company and the industry.
Furthermore, you’ll get:

An opportunity to play a key role in scaling a fintech platform that powers funding for thousands of entrepreneurs

A central leadership position in our tech organization, with real influence on how we work and deliver

Fabulous office overlooking Stockholm

We prioritize working in the office to maximize the positive impact of in-person collaboration, but we offer flexibility with work hours and remote work

Competitive compensation package

Insurance and pension plan

This role is all about building the teams and execution that power funding for thousands of entrepreneurs, if you're excited by our mission, apply or tell a friend!

What does it take to turn advanced semiconductor technology into products ready for customers and production? At Xenergic, it takes strong engineering, close collaboration and the ability to bring different technical disciplines together. We are now looking for an Engineering Manager to lead that work and develop our engineering organisation as we grow.
YOU WILL
Xenergic is a Lund-based semiconductor company developing high-speed, On-chip memory IP for advanced chip technologies. Our engineering teams work across several technical disciplines, developing technology that spans from transistor-level design to customer integration and mass production.
As Engineering Manager, you will lead Xenergic’s engineering organisation and take overall responsibility for product development and delivery. Working closely with the CEO, CTO and Business Development & Sales Manager, you will bring together technical direction, people and execution, ensuring that teams have the right priorities, resources and conditions to deliver.
This is a role for someone who wants to lead without losing touch with the technology. You will work across analog and digital design, software and verification, bringing different engineering disciplines together and creating the structure needed to turn advanced technology into reliable products and customer solutions.
Your main responsibilities will be to:

Lead and develop the engineering organisation across analog, digital, software and verification.

Take overall responsibility for product development and delivery, including resources, priorities, timelines and budgets.

Develop engineering processes, design methodologies and ways of working that support quality and efficient development.

Develop the team and its capabilities while creating clarity, collaboration and accountability across the organisation.

Ensure effective communication and documentation throughout product development and with relevant internal and external stakeholders.

The role reports to the CEO and is part of the management team. It is a full-time position based in Lund.
YOU ARE 
Your career has given you a strong technical foundation and experience in complex product development within semiconductors, electronics or another relevant technology environment. Over time, you have taken on broader responsibility and moved towards leading people, teams and technical delivery.
A technical university degree in electronics or a related field provides a strong foundation for the role. Equivalent technical experience may also be considered. Experience in the semiconductor industry is particularly valuable, especially within areas such as memory, chip design, verification, chip validation or silicon bring-up.
You have experience leading engineers and understand how to create the right conditions for highly skilled specialists to do their best work. You are comfortable setting priorities, making decisions and taking responsibility for delivery when several teams and technical disciplines need to work together.
As a leader, you are pragmatic and solution-oriented. You stay close enough to the technology to understand the challenges, ask the right questions and support your teams, without needing to be the expert in every technical detail. You bring structure when needed, while giving experienced engineers the trust and space to solve complex problems. Fluency in English is required.
At Xenergic, you will join a highly specialised engineering environment where technology and product development are closely connected. Short decision paths allow you to influence how the engineering organisation develops and how we take our technology from development to customer integration and production.
WANT TO KNOW MORE? 
In this recruitment, Xenergic is collaborating with Nexer Recruit. Applications are reviewed continuously, so please submit your application as soon as possible. For questions about the role or the recruitment process, please contact recruitment consultant Johanna Värmfors at johanna.varmfors@nexergroup.com or +46 730 821 230, or Artan Bitiqi at artan.bitiqi@nexergroup.com or +46 723 61 28 44.
We look forward to hearing from you.
ABOUT XENERGIC 
Xenergic is a Swedish semiconductor technology company based in Lund, developing high-speed, On-chip memory IP for advanced semiconductor applications.
Its technology addresses important challenges in modern chip design, where performance, power consumption and silicon area are becoming increasingly important. Xenergic’s solutions are relevant for applications ranging from IoT and mobile devices to networking, high-performance computing and AI.  Xenergic combines deep semiconductor expertise with a specialised engineering organisation and an international market. As we continue to develop our technology and products, joining Xenergic means becoming part of a small technology company where your work and ideas can have a real impact.

Job Scope 
Why does the role exist? High level purpose of function. 
The Senior Manufacturing Engineer plays a key role in process equipment commissioning, production ramp-up, and full-scale manufacturing within a battery cell production facility. They ensure smooth start-up of production lines, optimize manufacturing processes, and lead continuous improvement initiatives to maximize process yield, equipment availability, and overall production performance. This role combines hands-on equipment commissioning experience, cross-functional collaboration, and technical expertise to deliver safe, efficient, and high-quality battery cell production. A Senior Manufacturing Engineer is responsible for all aspects of their process machine including technical functionality, how personnel interact with it, what maintenance activities are recommended and what crucial spares are required. 
Key Responsibilities 
Overall areas of responsibilities and activities 
Key responsibilities include (but are not limited to) 
Participate in HAZOP (Hazard & Operability Study) sessions and ensure compliance with process safety, operational safety, and environmental standards.  
Promote a culture of safety, quality, and operational excellence throughout production and commissioning activities.  
Lead process equipment commissioning, including cold and hot commissioning on-site during start-up or restart projects. (Project timeline dependent)  
Facilitate smooth transitions from commissioning to production ramp-up and full-scale manufacturing. (Project timeline dependent)  
Translate lessons learned into design and process improvements for future expansions.  
Monitor, analyze and improve production KPIs, including yield, availability, and performance. Identifying top losses, production bottlenecks, and performance gaps to drive corrective actions and continuous improvement initiatives.  
Lead root cause analysis (RCA) for equipment-related losses, minor stops, and process deviations.  
Define, release, and maintain manufacturing process standards and operator training programs.  
Train and mentor new engineers, operators and other support functions.  
Prepare, review, and approve documentation including (but not limited to WI, PFMEAs, commissioning checklists, project timelines, A3s).   
Provide technical feedback and guidance to suppliers to ensure equipment quality, compliance with specifications, and CE standards.  
Develop and issue DOEs (Design of Experiments) and schedule process and equipment trials onsite and at supplier sites (if required).  
Deliver a line capable of obtaining PPAP approval, following a structured quality gate model.   
Guide and mentor colleagues to industrial best practices, focusing on growth and development.  
Complete supplementary tasks as seen fit by management to effectively utilize time and resource for the benefit of the business.  
This role requires regular presence on the production floor. 

 Requirements 
Educational background and previous experience required for the role 
Qualifications and Experience 
Master's degree in mechanical, electrical, or chemical engineering.  
Minimum of 7 years of relevant work experience in production, equipment, or engineering-related roles.  
Proven track record of leading manufacturing process improvements and production optimization in a factory environment following recognised project management techniques.   
Experience in building and scaling production in a fast-growing environment, ideally within the battery, food, pharma, paper & pulp, semiconductor, electrochemical, or similar industries.  
Hands-on experience and interest in equipment commissioning, troubleshooting, and optimisation.  
Proficient in detailed root cause analysis, structured problem-solving methodologies and continuous improvement.  
Familiarity with quality assurance troubleshooting tools.  
Experience working to industry standards obtaining certification including ISO, IATF &VDA.  
Experience with statistical process control and process capability analysis. 
Experience working with preventive maintenance strategies and Total Productive Maintenance (TPM) concepts within a production environment. 
Experience in spare part prioritisation and stock optimisation, balancing equipment availability with cost efficiency. 

 Specific skills & Knowledge  
Strong knowledge of mechanical, electrical, hydraulic, and pneumatic systems.  
Knowledge of OEE (Overall Equipment Effectiveness) metrics and their application in production environments.  
Knowledge of lean manufacturing principles and six sigma methodologies.  
Highly autonomous with a proactive mindset and work ethic.   
Strong technical curiosity, analytical mindset, and business-oriented problem-solving skills.  
Troubleshooting skills with diagnostic equipment.  
Ability to document technical problems concisely.  
Proficient in the use of a Computerised Maintenance Management System (CMMS) for work order management, equipment data, and maintenance reporting. Experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 is advantageous. 
Experience in coaching, upskilling, and mentoring engineers or technicians, with a demonstrable commitment to developing the technical capability of others within a production environment. 
Excellent English skills, both written and oral, are essential. Basic Swedish and other language skills are a plus. You should have good communication skills and be able to work in close collaboration with colleagues from many different teams.  
Ability to work within varying environments including clean-rooms and dry-rooms, while wearing appropriate PPE.  
Comfortable operating in high-profile, international, and high-pressure environments.  
A genuine technical interest and passion about working within production is highly valued.

jobs.occupation: Senior Data Engineer to Sergel Group
jobs.description:
Sergel Group is one of the leading providers of credit management services in the Nordic region. We offer services within credit scoring, debt collection, debt purchasing, as well as messaging and payment solutions. Sergel is part of Marginalen Group and has just over 150 employees across Sweden, Denmark, Norway, and Finland. 
About the role
Sergel is on an exciting journey to strengthen its inhouse capabilities, bringing more competence and ownership closer to the business. This means several ongoing development areas and new projects where data plays a central role, and the people who work with it are central to Sergel's ability to compete and grow across the Nordic market.
In this role you will drive the development of scalable, efficient and compliant data solutions, with a strong focus on operational excellence and exploring new opportunities for innovation. You will have significant autonomy and a broad mandate to influence technical direction, make key decisions and ensure they are executed with real impact. We are looking for someone who combines strong technical expertise with a natural drive to take ownership and move things forward. Over time, you are motivated by the opportunity to take on greater responsibility and a more leading position within the area.
Your responsibilities will include:

Defining and enforcing data modeling standards, best practices and governance policies.

Designing and maintaining scalable data pipelines and optimizing ETL processes.

Building and maintaining applications and integrations for data ingestion, transformation and delivery.

Driving the shift from external-dependent delivery toward strong in-house capability.

Setting the technical direction and owning key architectural decisions.

Ensuring that BI is an integral part of the data platform, enabling trusted reporting, analytics and data-driven decision-making across the organization.

Qualifications and experience
You are someone who combines deep technical expertise with a natural drive to take ownership. You communicate clearly across technical and non-technical stakeholders and thrive in environments where you can shape and improve things rather than just maintain them.
You enjoy working closely with others, sharing knowledge and helping the team grow through collaboration, curiosity and mutual respect. You are humble enough to listen and confident enough to challenge when needed.
You also bring:

Solid experience as a data engineer and experience with designing, modeling and implementing data-intensive systems.

Strong proficiency in SQL and C# .NET/Python.

Experience with ETL tools, data pipeline frameworks and orchestration tools.

Understanding of CI/CD principles.

Knowledge of data governance, GDPR compliance and security best practices.

The ability to drive technical decisions and set standards.

Fluency in English.

Valid work permit.

You don't need to be senior in every area listed above, if you bring strong fundamentals and the right mindset, there is room to develop and grow into the full scope of the role.
Meriting experience:

Experience from financial services, credit or similar data-intensive industries.

Knowledge in one of the nordic languages.

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, or a related field.

About the company
In Sergel we care about the people we meet. We are a company with a culture based on trust and learning, where we work towards strengthening individuals through competence, compassion and a high level of engagement. Together we work with clear ownership and shared responsibility towards our stakeholders, which creates long-term and loyal business relations. We always try to find new ways of working and challenging the market. We want our employees to develop with the company and have fun with their colleagues on the way.
Additional information
Start: By agreement

Location: Central Stockholm

Extent: Full-time

Salary: By agreement

Vill du vara med och forma hur nordiska företag använder data och AI för att skapa affärsvärde?
På Columbus Data & AI hjälper vi företag att gå från data till beslut, innovation och konkurrenskraft. Nu förstärker vi vårt team med en senior profil som vill driva området Data Strategy & AI och hjälpa våra kunder att ta nästa steg i sin datadrivna transformation.
Om rollen
Som Principal Consultant inom Data & AI Strategy kommer du att vara en nyckelperson i vårt erbjudande och vår fortsatta tillväxt. Du arbetar nära kundernas ledningsgrupper och verksamhetsansvariga för att definiera strategier, identifiera möjligheter och säkerställa att investeringar inom data och AI leder till konkreta affärsresultat.
Du kombinerar strategiskt tänkande med affärsutveckling och är bekväm med att leda dialoger från vision och roadmap till genomförande.
I rollen kommer du bland annat att:

Utveckla och driva Columbus erbjudande inom Data Strategy & AI.

Stötta kunder i att skapa data- och AI-strategier som är starkt förankrade i verksamhetens mål.

Facilitera workshops och leda dialoger med ledningsgrupper och beslutsfattare.

Identifiera affärsmöjligheter och bidra till försäljning och tillväxt inom området.

Bygga långsiktiga kundrelationer och agera strategisk rådgivare.

Samarbeta med våra specialistteam inom data engineering, analytics, AI och modern dataplattform.

Kravprofil
Vi tror att du har en bakgrund som managementkonsult, strategikonsult eller senior rådgivare inom data, analytics eller digital transformation. Du har erfarenhet av att arbeta nära ledningsgrupper och kan översätta tekniska möjligheter till affärsvärde.
Vi söker dig som:

Har flerårig erfarenhet av data- och analysområdet och möjligheter inom AI och generativ AI.

Har arbetat med datastrategier, operating models, governance eller datadriven transformation.

Är trygg i dialog med beslutsfattare på C-level.

Har ett starkt kommersiellt driv och trivs med att utveckla affärer.

Kan skapa förtroende på både strategisk och operativ nivå.

Please note - this position is located in Sweden. It requires a valid VISA and fluency in Swedish and English.  
Ansökan och nästa steg
Hos oss ansöker du enkelt med din LinkedIn-profil eller ditt CV, utan att behöva fylla i långa frågeformulär. Du behöver inte skicka in något personligt brev. 
I vår rekryteringsprocess använder vi logik- och personlighetstester. Vi tar alltid referenser och genomför en bakgrundskontroll innan anställning eller erbjudande ges. Intervjuer sker löpande. Vid frågor är du välkommen att kontakta ansvarig rekryterare Daniel Sparrow. 
Efter avslutad rekryteringsprocess skickar vi en fråga om din upplevelse som kandidat. Det tar bara någon sekund att besvara frågan och hjälper oss att förbättra vår rekryteringsprocess.
Om Data & AI
Vilka är vi? Vi är ett team med BI-konsulter som levererar data- och AI-projekt inom Business Intelligence, AI och Machine Learning. Vi samarbetar nära med konsulter från andra affärsområden – Dynamics, M3 och Digital Commerce.
Varför? Vi vill hjälpa våra kunder att nå sina affärsmål och göra deras vardag mer effektiv! Målet är att säkerställa deras långsiktiga framgång och guida kunderna genom att vara deras Trusted Advisor. Vi samarbetar med kunderna för att optimera deras lösningar. 💫
Jobba på Columbus
Människorna kommer alltid först på Columbus. Vi är ett globalt konsultbolag med lokal närvaro, som hjälper företag med deras digitala förändring och att blomstra genom teknik, data och mänsklig insikt. Vi är också en arbetsplats där du som medarbetare får utveckla din karriär och få stöd genom tydliga och strukturerade karriärvägar.  
Vår kultur bygger på tillit, samarbete, nyfikenhet och ett gemensamt engagemang för att leverera värde till våra kunder. Oavsett om du är erfaren eller precis i början av din karriär, kommer du att hitta friheten att utforska idéer, utmana det invanda och forma din egen väg hos oss.  
Med över 1 500 kollegor i fler än 10 länder kombinerar vi globala perspektiv med lokal förståelse. Det som förenar oss är vår tro på att skapa en meningsfull påverkan – för våra medarbetare, våra kunder och resan framåt.
Let’s thrive, grow, and shape the future together.  
Vad andra säger om oss
Intresserad av Columbus bakom kulisserna? Varje vecka låter vi en kollega ta över vårt Instagram-konto. 
På Careereye kan nuvarande och tidigare medarbetare dela sina ofiltrerade omdömen om hur det är att arbeta hos oss. Klicka nedan för att läsa deras upplevelser.

Cambio is one of the Nordics' leading suppliers in e-health with a comprehensive offering for the entire health and care chain. Our e-health solutions supports health care professionals in their daily work and offer patients safer and more easily accessible care. We are proud to be an important part of Swedish healthcare. We are growing continuously and now have about 1000 employees in several countries.

The position We are looking for a DevOps Engineer who wants to play an active role in how we build, deploy, operate and continuously improve products within Cambio’s Social Care portfolio.
You will work with both modern SaaS and container-based solutions as well as established products used in our customers’ daily operations. Your focus will be on automation, CI/CD, deployment, monitoring and operational reliability across different delivery models.
This is a hands-on role where you will combine technical implementation with collaboration across teams, customers, suppliers and other stakeholders. You will help modernize our delivery processes and influence how DevOps and platform capabilities evolve within Social Care.
Some of the things you’ll do
· Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines and automated release processes.
· Develop and operate container-based environments using Kubernetes or OpenShift.
· Improve deployment processes through automation and Infrastructure as Code.
· Strengthen monitoring, observability and operational reliability.
· Work closely with developers, architects, support and operations.
· Engage with customers, suppliers and internal stakeholders to understand needs and improve delivery models.
· Contribute to the modernization of existing products and services towards more scalable and automated delivery models.

We offer At Cambio, you do not just work with technology. You help build solutions that support important work in health and social care. You will be part of modernizing an established product portfolio, deepen your skills in DevOps, automation and containerization, and grow through increased responsibility, ownership and technical challenges.
At Cambio, we encourage initiative, continuous learning and knowledge sharing. Our culture is built on Trust, Care and Together.

About you You have a few years of experience within DevOps, infrastructure, operations, platform engineering or software delivery and are looking for a role where you can take greater ownership while continuing to grow professionally.
You are curious, proactive and enjoy solving problems. You take initiative, learn independently and find practical ways forward, especially in environments where not everything is fully defined.
We believe you have experience with some of the following
· DevOps, infrastructure, operations or platform engineering.
· Scripting or automation using PowerShell, Bash, Python or similar.
· CI/CD pipelines and software delivery automation.
· Containers and orchestration platforms such as Docker, Kubernetes or similar.
· Infrastructure automation or Infrastructure as Code.
· Monitoring, logging and observability.
· SQL databases.
· Swedish and English, verbally as well as in writing
Just as important as specific technologies is your ability to learn, take ownership and continuously improve how systems are built, deployed and operated.
 Place of employment: Linköping or Motala.
Scope: Full-time, hybrid work model (three days per week in-office)
Form of employment: Permanent employment, 6 months trial period
Additional Information: The role involves access to sensitive information, therefore a background check will be conducted on the final candidate.
We review applications and conduct interviews on a rolling basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible via the link.
We look forward to receiving your application!
